description: This Java class defines the ResourceModified event, which is emitted after a Resource object is modified within a policy. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, accessing its properties, and serializing to JSON. The class also contains metadata annotations for serialization/deserialization and immutability.

classes.name: ResourceModified
classes.description: Represents an event emitted after a Resource in a policy has been modified. It provides access to the modified resource, associated label, and methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating ResourceModified instances with various parameters, including deprecated overloads.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourceModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry associated with the modified resource.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON entity representing the resource, according to a specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource within the event's JSON structure.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ResourceModified with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the event's payload into a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and filtering predicate.
